title: How to Rebuild Your Attention Span: The Focus Mistake You May Be Making
description: Learn how to rebuild your attention span by creating better focus habits, reducing distractions, and restoring mental clarity in a constantly connected world. This guide explains why concentration feels harder, how digital interruptions affect your focus, and practical ways to train deeper attention. Discover the one-week attention awareness exercise that helps you identify what is stealing your focus before changing your habits. Tap to read the full guide.
